relations.subject: George Foot Moore
relations.evidence: entered Yale College as a junior in 1870, then graduated from Yale in 1872

relations.subject: George Foot Moore
relations.evidence: graduated from Union Theological Seminary (New York) in 1877

relations.subject: George Foot Moore
relations.evidence: In 1883 he was appointed to the chair of Hebrew at Andover Theological Seminary where he taught until 1902

relations.subject: George Foot Moore
relations.evidence: In 1902, he became a professor at the Harvard Divinity School, where he was appointed Frothingham Professor of the History of Religion in 1905
